scope.source_selector: replay the frozen R50G22 family and retain only exact_pre_bve_clean plus IMMEDIATE_BVE_W4_ESCAPE on pivot 1

questions: What exact R47J normalization cascade sends each of the 30 skeletons to DIRECT_EMPTY_CNF?
What is the longest exact common transition prefix across all 30 cascades?
What first transition must a genuine anti-collapse counterexample prevent or avoid?
For that first transition, what is the minimum necessary direct-blocking clause debt under pure clause addition at the same state?

direct_blocking_debt_contract.TAUTOLOGY_DELETION: pure addition cannot invalidate an already tautological clause; direct block impossible
direct_blocking_debt_contract.UNIT_PROPAGATION_WITH_RECONSTRUCTION_TRA: pure addition cannot remove the existing unit; direct block impossible
direct_blocking_debt_contract.PURE_LITERAL_AUTARKY: direct block requires at least one added opposite-polarity occurrence of that variable
direct_blocking_debt_contract.SUBSUMPTION: pure addition cannot destroy an existing subset relation; direct block impossible
direct_blocking_debt_contract.BLOCKED_CLAUSE_ELIMINATION: direct block requires at least one added opposite-blocking-literal clause yielding a non-tautological resolvent with the blocked clause
direct_blocking_debt_contract.BOUNDED_VARIABLE_ELIMINATION: a distinct added clause not containing the pivot cannot turn an accepted BVE into a rejected one; direct block therefore requires at least one added pivot occurrence or non-additive modification
direct_blocking_debt_contract.SINGLE_LITERAL_RUP: UP conflict certificates are monotone under clause addition; direct block by addition at the same state is impossible
